t: Masterbuilt vs Smokin' It Smokehouses - looking for recommendations - Smoked-Meat Forums
s: Something I noticed while looking at these things: - Masterbuilt New Gen 40"...a LOT of temp variance on all racks (not good) - the Amazen works on ALL of these (very good :) - the Bradley is 500-watt, but the Smokin' It is only 350-watt (surprised by that) So far, the Bradley seems the best fit. Being able to use the AMNPS in it will save a lot on the pucks. May need to bump budget and get the 6-rack tho. I really wish the MES was a more stable unit. Just seems to be hit-or-miss with buyers.

January 30, 2022 - I have a #1 and a #3. I bought the #3 thinking that if I decided digital control was needed, it wouldn't be that hard to use a stand alone Auber controller and bypass the analog controller. 3 years later, I'm still analog only and don't anticipate any urgency in getting a digital controller. I read all those reviews as well and haven't had the same negative reactions. I would buy a Smokin-it again if mine somehow gets destroyed.
American made.........they are great! Never been happier with a smoker before..........you can use your own wood you gather or buy chunks on the internet!

t: Opinion of Smokin It? | THE BBQ BRETHREN FORUMS
s: May 6, 2020 - No matter what I cooked in that smoker and how I fiddled around with it, the food was smoky campfire. I sold it later last summer and got my money back. If you can find a used one, go for it, maybe you'll like it. But, I wouldn't recommend buying a new one unless you've been able to try some food from one and like the flavor profile.
